structs.name: ID3D12Device
structs.size_evidence: COM interface. Every Replay access is a vtable load from the device pointer followed by an indirect call: R_CreateDescriptorHeap@0x1418781D0 (`*device` then slots +112, +120), R_InitGlobalNullDescriptors@0x141879740 (`*device` then +144, +152, +160), R_InitCommandSignatures@0x141878C40 (`*device` then +328), R_InitRootSignatures@0x141879A70 (`*device` then +128). R_DispatchIndirect and R_GetBufferDataInternal call g_d3d12Device +216 and +304 the same way. No byte past +0 is read.
unconfirmed: game-test members at 16..88 (m_NullConstantBufferAddress, m_Reserved, ID3D12Object base): no Replay access, and they belong to the D3D runtime's own object, not to Replay
structs.notes: Keep IDA as is: size 8, vtable pointer only. Do not apply the game-test 88 (builder 88): it is not proven and no Replay code reads the object past +0. The coordinator should not add any member after vtbl.

structs.name: ID3D12Pageable
structs.size_evidence: COM interface, base of ID3D12Resource and ID3D12PipelineState. No Replay function reads a Pageable member. Its only Replay use is through the derived objects' vtables: R_DX12_GetResourceSize@0x1418DBD70 (`*(resource)+80`), R_GetBufferDataInternal@0x1418C11F0 (`*(gpuResource)+80`, `*(v151)+64/+72/+16`), R_SetPipelineState@0x141989850 (vfunc +200 of the context, pso passed as an argument, never dereferenced).
members: vtable pointer only, reached as [obj] then indirect call in the Resource and PSO functions listed in size_evidence
unconfirmed: game-test base ID3D12DeviceChild is not in this build's layout
structs.notes: Opaque, keep the 8-byte vtable pointer. Game-test size 16 comes from the ID3D12DeviceChild base and is not Replay evidence. Pageable is not held by value in any struct Replay uses (the only IDA parent is ID3D12PipelineState, itself opaque).

structs.name: ID3D12PipelineState
structs.size_evidence: COM interface. R_SetPipelineState@0x141989850 takes the PSO pointer from a technique table entry (`*(v19+8)`), compares it with the cached pointer at drawState+4488, and passes it to the context vfunc at +200. The object is never dereferenced, so no member offset is accessed. Game-test's m_Packet (16..48) has no Replay access.
members: vtable pointer only; PSO is passed to vfunc +200 at R_SetPipelineState@0x141989850 without a member load
changed_members: remove m_Packet and the 32-byte body; size 40 -> 8 (PROPOSAL, changes total size and deletes a member)
unconfirmed: m_Packet: game-test-only wrapper, no Replay access found
structs.notes: Opaque. Current IDA layout (40 bytes, m_Packet at 8) is not supported by Replay; the coordinator may apply the 8-byte opaque form as a size-changing proposal. The PSO is not embedded by value in any Replay struct (IDA embedded_in is empty).

structs.name: ID3D12Resource
structs.size_evidence: COM interface. Every Replay access of a resource pointer is a vtable load and indirect call: R_DX12_GetResourceSize@0x1418DBD70 `(*(resource)+80)(resource, out)`; R_GetBufferDataInternal@0x1418C11F0 `(*(gpuResource)+80)(gpuResource, v167)` and the gpuResource argument is passed to the immediate-context vfuncs (+208, +152) and never dereferenced as a struct. The +16 access in the packet's replay_functions list is not a Resource member: R_DispatchIndirect@0x1418BD540 reads `argsBuffer[2]` where `argsBuffer` is `_QWORD *` (a parameter of a different type), so it is not evidence for offset 16.
unconfirmed: size 16 (game-test, from ID3D12Pageable base): no Replay evidence
anchor at +16 from R_DispatchIndirect: wrong struct, argsBuffer is a QWORD array
structs.notes: Opaque, keep size 8 vtable pointer. Do not apply the builder's 16 and do not treat R_DispatchIndirect's +16 as a Resource member. Agrees with first pass A114.
